spotify.create_playlist only converts SpotifyError and selected HTTP statuses to DuetCreationUncertain. If its transport raises TimeoutError after a POST may have reached Spotify, the raw TimeoutError escapes (reproduced with one recorded POST), so the required uncertainty error and operator recovery instruction are absent. Rule: Every ambiguous create transport failure must surface as DuetCreationUncertain without automatically repeating the non-idempotent POST or persisting an id.. Scope: All transport exceptions from the create POST, including timeouts and connection resets through both the fake transport and urllib path.. Verify: A fake transport that records the POST then raises TimeoutError or ConnectionError must produce DuetCreationUncertain, record exactly one POST, and leave duet.playlist_id unset..

spotify.api_request retries a PUT after HTTP 429/5xx, but a transient transport failure raises SpotifyError from _get_once and bypasses the retry loop. A fake transport whose first PUT raises a connection error and whose second would succeed therefore fails the Refresh without retrying the full ordered URI payload, contrary to the task note's whole-call backoff requirement. Rule: Transient full-replacement PUT failures must retry the same complete URI array with bounded backoff; they must never fall back to partial item writes.. Scope: The PUT request policy for transport-level transient failures as well as retryable HTTP responses.. Verify: Have a fake PUT fail once with a transient transport error, then succeed; assert two identical full-array PUT attempts, a backoff call, and storage of the successful snapshot_id..

When the PUT ultimately fails, playlist.refresh_duet and app.cmd_refresh record the failed run and print an error, but no alert is sent. A 403 or exhausted 5xx therefore leaves the Duet alone without the alert required by docs/PLAN.md §4.4 and this task's notes. Rule: A failed Duet write must leave the Duet and duet_state untouched and emit an alert after the permitted whole-call retries are exhausted.. Scope: Every terminal PUT failure path in the Refresh command, including nonretryable statuses, exhausted retries, and transport failures.. Verify: Inject a fake failing PUT and a fake alert sink; assert one alert after final failure, unchanged duet_state and snapshot_id, and no partial writes..
